SMARTGRAPHVALUE.description: Smart Graph Value (SMARTGRAPHVALUE). The TYPE selects which smart-graph result category to read, and the optional KEY narrows it to a single function; when KEY is omitted, all functions of that TYPE are returned.

Argument.description: Request body for reading smart graph values.

TYPE.description: Smart Graph Data - Type. Selects the smart-graph result category (case-insensitive). THRG=Time History Global Result; THRI=Time History Inter-story Result; THRS=Time History Story-Drift/Shear Result; THEF/THRE=Time History Element Force Result; POEF=Pushover Element Force; PORG=Pushover Global Result; PORE=Pushover Element Result; PORI=Pushover Inter-story Result; THSF=Story Shear Force Result.

KEY.description: Smart Graph Data - Key. Optional function key within the selected TYPE; must be a valid existing key for that TYPE or the request is rejected. When omitted, every function key of the selected TYPE is returned.
